compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies:
- DD1: contract doc updated to reflect SHA-range validation in load_for_region
- DD2: contract doc updated to reflect legacy fallback behavior

## Doc Router Gate
Gate 2 fires: this is a reference contract document (plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md) that defines a cross-component interface — it belongs in the existing contracts docs directory, not in SKILL.md.

## Implementation Notes
Modify plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md:

1. Add two new optional fields to the Record Shape table:
   - story_branch_tip_sha: string, optional, SHA of story branch tip at attestation time
   - story_branch_base_sha: string, optional, SHA of story branch base (fork point) at attestation time

2. Update load_for_region documentation:
   - When record has both story_branch_tip_sha and story_branch_base_sha: validate via git log --ancestry-path <base>..<tip>. Include record only if query SHA is in ancestry.
   - When record lacks sha fields (legacy): fall back to diff_hash equality; log warning.

3. Add a 'Schema Migration' section describing absence=legacy contract.

4. Update the Change Log with: '2026-05-11: Add story_branch_tip_sha/story_branch_base_sha fields; load_for_region SHA-range membership validation; legacy fallback contract.'

Emit DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION in completion report: Gate 2 fired, target plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md.

- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md: modify
